'''Nhat Lai Mains & Toys Revisited (Intermediate)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Nhat Lai]]
* '''Published:''' June 1999 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Premiere-L-tatooineobiwanshut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Mains & Toys Revisited (Intermediate)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Mains & Toys Revisited (Intermedi.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Here's an example of another of the decks that's seeing lots of play in the southern Alderaan region.

== Strategy ==

No surprises here. Spread out on Tatooine and do the standard Mos Eisley shuffle, using the skiffs to react to any battles that may occur. Ben Kenobi is just so powerful in battles with the other mains, and when combined with the battle-related interrupts can seriously cripple an opponent's ground offensive quickly.

Sense and Alter make a showing but in moderate quantities. Use Bacta Tank and Docking and Repair Facilities to recycle those characters and starships lost from table. Use Revolution to deny your opponent Force while giving you the added Force generation instead. Or, use them to create that wonderful Force drain location. Getting Ben Kenobi on the table is key for this deck. Destiny isn't too bad either.
